items.t: Piston ring defect can damage the engine (recall)
items.job: Install knock-sensing software; replace engine if damaged
items.note: Free under recalls SC209 and SC336. Check your VIN.

items.t: IVT transmission slips or hesitates
items.job: Transmission software update; replace IVT if damaged
items.note: Covered free by Kia campaign SC199 for eligible VINs, and the 10-year/100,000-mile powertrain warranty covers original owners.

items.t: Transmission oil pump controller can overheat and burn (recall)
items.job: Replace electric oil pump controller

items.t: Side curtain airbags may deploy on their own (recall)
items.job: Replace both side curtain airbag modules

items.t: Engine stalls or shuts off while driving
items.job: Diagnose stalling (scan codes, check software and sensors)
items.note: Should be covered by the factory warranty on 2024 models. Cost depends on what is found.

items.t: Engine burning oil between changes
items.job: Oil consumption test at dealer
items.note: If the engine fails the test it is usually replaced under the powertrain warranty or the piston ring recall.

items.t: AWD warning light from a water-damaged AWD computer
items.job: Inspect and replace AWD control unit, add protective cover
items.note: Free under Kia service campaign SC297 for eligible VINs.

items.t: AWD transfer case leaks oil or smells burnt with the spare tire on
items.job: Inspect transfer case and update AWD software
items.note: Free under Kia service campaign SC242. If the seal is leaking, the dealer repairs it under the campaign.

items.t: Instrument cluster stays dark in cold weather
items.job: Diagnose cluster; software update or replace cluster
items.note: Should be covered by the factory warranty. Low end is a software update, high end a new cluster.

items.t: Horn stops working
items.job: Replace horn
items.note: If the clock spring in the steering wheel is the cause, parts cost more.

items.t: Creaking or clunking when turning the steering wheel
items.job: Replace front strut bearings and upper spring pads (both sides)
items.note: Covered under warranty if still in the basic coverage period. An alignment is usually needed afterward.

items.t: Easy theft on key-start models without an immobilizer
items.job: Install anti-theft software update
items.note: Free at Kia dealers under campaign CS2309. Damage from a break-in costs more.

items.t: Dual-clutch transmission goes into limp mode
items.job: Transmission software update
items.note: Done free under warranty on most cars.

items.t: Check engine light with codes P0605 or P2181
items.job: Engine computer software update
items.note: Done free under warranty on most cars.

items.t: Front camera warning and driver-assist faults
items.job: Front camera software update or replacement and calibration
items.note: Low end is a software update. A new camera costs more.

items.t: Power steering warning light at start-up
items.job: Power steering software update

items.t: Several warning lights at once from stability control code C1626
items.job: ABS/stability control software update
items.note: Mismatched tires or a bad alignment should be fixed too.

items.t: Instrument cluster restarts during navigation
items.job: Instrument cluster software update

items.t: Radio won't respond on the touchscreen
items.job: Head unit software update

items.t: Power side mirrors won't adjust
items.job: Inspect and replace power mirror switch

items.t: Low-beam headlights look dim or aimed too low
items.job: Headlight aim adjustment
items.note: If a bulb is weak, a new bulb adds a small parts cost.

items.t: Rattle or clunk from the rear seat
items.job: Inspect and adjust rear seat latches
